name: voicecheckout
description: VoiceCheckout - Chrome extension for voice-guided checkout

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.store.config.ts && tsc --noEmit && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp -r public/icons dist/ && cp dist/public/popup.html dist/popup.html && cp index.html dist/index.html
